canonical_oracle_nontransferability: S3-002 canonical labels do not label any EXP-S4-002 program.
execution_isolation: one hard-budgeted subprocess per program; ok, timeout, exception, and resource_truncated records are retained, and a failed program cannot suppress later program records or prevent a complete phase seal

geometry_oracle.required_coverage_derivation: The oracle recomputes coverage from the frozen scene checked-pair policy and complete source move start/end bindings; evidence input cannot declare required coverage.
geometry_oracle.trajectory_start_binding: The independent oracle replays frozen trajectory endpoints from zero initial joints and requires each move current joint state to equal the content-addressed trajectory start; mismatch is invalid(TRAJECTORY_START_BINDING_MISMATCH).
geometry_oracle.safe_rule: nonempty complete independently derived checked-pair continuous interval coverage with strictly positive conservative lower bounds; no-move geometry returns unknown, never verified, and only the total oracle may waive that exact independently proven no-move obligation

logical_oracle.trace_source: sealed source-event trace produced by the independent AST interpreter from immutable program source and asset durations; every source action has start/end, source span, canonical and execution ordinals, a unique terminal record, and all four mode×ready valuations
logical_oracle.program_verdict: invalid dominates; otherwise any logical or geometry violation is unsafe; otherwise any missing, unresolved, or incomplete component is unknown; safe requires logical verification and geometry verification for every move-bearing trace, with only exact producer-proven no-move geometry unknown waived
